{{Quote|In the beautiful Lakes Region of eaquatorial Alderaan, native wildlife life abounds...|Alderaanian tourist board Holoplay #2735|<ref name="Star Wars (2013) 2">[[Star Wars (2013) 2|''Star Wars'' (2013) 2]]</ref>}}
The '''Lakes Region''' was an area of the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], located on the planet's equator. It had rich biodiversity and was considered a beauteous place. During its time, the [[Alderaanian tourist board]] mentioned the Lakes Region in [[Alderaanian tourist board Holoplay 2735|one]] of its holocommercials.
